people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Zoan
people.line: An ancient Egyptian city, probably Tanis

translations.web: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
translations.bsb: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
translations.kjv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
translations.asv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
